== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|The [[Frozen Blade]] school, also known as the [[Frozen Blade]] sect, is a powerful organization headquartered in a snowy region. The sect manages vast territories and serves as a protector for an entire nation, shielding its people from environmental hazards, invaders, and various threats. Their responsibilities include defending civilians against [[aura]]-storms and stray [[Remnants]]. The sect's home is a harsh environment characterized by freezing winds and jagged ice blades infused with [[sword aura]], making it dangerous for anyone below the rank of [[Truegold]] to visit. The school is led by a [[Sage]], and its members utilize specialized techniques involving [[Frozen Blade madra]] and icy [[aura]]. These combat styles can include freezing an opponent's movement or utilizing shards of ice to strike. The sect's members, such as Underladies and students, participate in competitive rankings and have been known to deploy cloudships for travel.}}

== Wintersteel ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|The [[Frozen Blade]] School is an institution remembered by [[Timaias Adama|Adama]] that maintains its headquarters within a snowy region. This sect manages a vast expanse of land where they protect the local population from environmental threats and invaders, including the defense of a specific snowy village. Within their organization, only [[Truegold|Truegolds]] on the [[Path of the Frozen Blade]] are permitted to visit the [[Sage]]'s home. Members of the school have been noted aboard the [[Akura family cloudship|Akura cloudship]] and serving on their backup team. Additionally, the school assigns its members to safeguard civilians against [[aura]]-storms and [[Remnants]].}}
